text:
If you’re heading out early, bundle up for a 43-degree start, then enjoy a beautiful recovery into the mid 60s. Sunshine holds all day, with only a light north breeze, and the air quality is clean. The lake stays friendly for a paddle or waterfront walk, with waves a foot or less and north winds around 5 to 10 knots. The water is still 63, so swimming will feel brisk.

Tonight stays clear and cool, with temperatures dipping back near 43. The forecasters are warning that frost is likely again in colder spots, so cover the tender plants before bed. Thursday looks much like today, sunny and seasonable, with a high near 67, though the forecast spread runs from the mid 60s to near 70. Make today an easy outdoor day, but dress in layers for the morning and protect anything frost-sensitive tonight.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Wednesday! It was once again a cool start to our Wednesday morning with most places starting off in the 30s and lower 40s. But plenty of sunshine on the way through the day ahead means we’ll see temperatures warm up a lot closer to where we should be for this time of year. Under mostly sunny skies this afternoon, high temperatures for the day head back into the mid and upper 60s. Clear skies tonight, though, will once again mean a cool and frosty night for some as lows dip into the 30s to about 40 by early Thursday morning.
